name: cascade_orphan_feeders
note: removing a neuron removes every feeder the removal orphans, to a fixed point

name: edge_target_becomes_constant
note: a hidden target with no inward edge left but an outward one becomes a constant, bias = squash(bias)

name: edge_source_becomes_dead
note: a hidden or constant source left with no outward edge is removed

name: edge_role_identity
note: only the requested (from, to, role) triple is removed, not every edge of the pair

name: if_repair_coalesces_roles
note: an IF missing a required role is downgraded to IDENTITY, roles stripped, coalesced rows summed

name: constant_moves_into_prefix
note: after a hidden→constant flip the slice is re-ordered constants-then-hiddens and synapses re-sorted

name: memetic_dropped_on_removal
note: a successful removal drops the content-derived identity — memetic, the half a CreatureExport carries

name: constant_bias_fold
note: compensation folds w · meanActivation of the removed neuron into each target's bias

failure.message: Neuron c-1 is a constant node and is protected from direct removal

name: static_if_rewrite
note: an IF whose condition the removal fixes is flattened to the surviving branch

name: restored_if_role
note: an IF branch the removal empties is given back a zero-weight support edge

name: constant_edge_folds_exactly
note: an edge from a constant folds into the target's bias and preserves the output

name: proxy_compensation
note: the correlated-survivor remedy: a weight share and the residual it leaves

name: single_edge_aggregate_converted
note: a MINIMUM left with one edge becomes IDENTITY, and the dropped term is named

name: aggregate_keeps_its_squash_with_two_edges
note: a MEAN still reducing two terms keeps its squash and reports what it lost

name: last_edge_into_output_folds_a_mean
note: an output left with nothing to sum takes the caller's mean into its bias

name: last_edge_from_a_constant_folds_exactly
note: an output left with nothing to sum folds a constant source exactly

name: last_edge_from_an_observation_folds_a_mean
note: an edge out of input-N is a candidate, and folds like any other

name: sole_source_of_two_outputs_folds_into_both
note: removing the only source of two outputs folds into each of their biases

name: one_output_of_several_loses_its_last_edge
note: only the output left with nothing to sum goes constant; the others do not

name: output_if_rewritten_in_place
note: an output carrying IF that loses its condition is rewritten, never downgraded

name: no_statistic_prunes_uncompensated
note: a removal with no statistics prunes anyway and names what went uncompensated

name: single_edge_hypot_v2_becomes_absolute
note: a HYPOTv2 left with one edge becomes ABSOLUTE, bias unchanged

name: zero_edge_aggregate_outputs_fold
note: an aggregate left with no inward edge takes the fold, HYPOTv2 as an ABSOLUTE

name: three_deep_chain_collapses
note: one removal strands a three-deep hidden chain and every level of it goes

name: protected_neuron_refused
note: an output neuron is not a caller's to delete

failure.message: Neuron output-0 is a output node and is protected from direct removal

name: unknown_role_refused
note: asking for a role a pair does not carry names no edge

failure.message: No synapse input-0 -> if-1 (Negative) to remove

name: malformed_missing_creature
note: a request naming no creature is a boundary fault, not a verdict

failure.message: MALFORMED_REQUEST: missing field `creature` at line 1 column 14

name: malformed_unknown_role
note: a role spelling the wire does not carry is refused, never defaulted

failure.message: MALFORMED_REQUEST: synapse type 'POSITIVE' is not one of standard, condition, negative, positive
